Why HaxOfi
Ranked

Find a match

1v1, 3v3 and Real Soccer with elo per mode and a ladder of the best. Haxman takes up to thirty players, each one guards their own goal and the last life standing wins.

Party

Play with friends

Form a party from your friends list and everyone lands on the same team. Each player picks a position, from keeper to striker. Private chat and who is online.

Shop

Levels, tokens and shop

Every match earns experience and tokens, more when you win. Trade them for pitches and balls with their own trail and sound, and use them in all your matches.

Stadium

Team entrance

Stands in each team's colours, banners, smoke, flares and fireworks as the teams walk out.

Stands

Cheer from the stands

Join a room's stands with your team, move through the crowd and light flares, firecrackers and roman candles.

Clips

Clips of every goal

Every goal replays in a corner while the match goes on. Press C to clip any play and save it as an MP4, ready to post on Discord.

Classic Haxball, improved
Rotation

Always the same side

Pick left or right and the pitch flips on its own to match your team: you always attack the same way. You can also flip the view top to bottom if that feels better.

Rooms

Rooms and hosting

Room list with favourites, recently visited and a country filter. When you host, change the name and player limit after the room is up and turn on plugins and modes like 8MAN or Real Soccer without scripts.

Stream

Streamer mode

A separate window with its own extrapolation, the scoreboard, the minimap, the chat and the keys you press. Ready to capture in OBS.

Scoreboard

Scoreboard

Three designs with the app crest, scorer and assist on every goal and overtime under the clock. You can also build your own in HTML and CSS.

Style

Your way

Minimap, a 3D ball that spins the way it travels, ball and halo colours, your own kits, chat macros and eight themes for the whole app.

FPS

Performance

Three graphics levels: Medium drops the pyrotechnics and Low also drops the stadium and ball effects. FPS cap and resolution scale for smooth play on any PC.

Your download has started

The app is not digitally signed, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning when you open it. We just have not bought a signing certificate.

If the warning shows up, click More info and then Run anyway.

SmartScreen is not an antivirus. It only warns that the app is unsigned, and your antivirus keeps checking the app as usual.

Which Mac do you have?

Open the Apple menu and choose About This Mac. If Chip says Apple M1, M2 or later, it is Apple Silicon. If it says Processor Intel, it is Intel.

Apple Silicon Intel

Your download has started

The app is not signed by Apple, so macOS blocks it the first time you open it.

Open the .dmg and drag HaxOfi to Applications. Open it once, close the warning and go to System Settings, Privacy & Security. HaxOfi shows up at the bottom: click Open Anyway.

If macOS says the app is damaged, open Terminal and paste xattr -cr /Applications/HaxOfi.app

Your download has started

The app installs from the .apk file, not from the Play Store. It needs Android 9 or later. On a computer? Open haxofi.com on your phone.

If the browser warns that the file might be harmful, tap Download anyway.

When the download finishes, open the file. If Android asks for permission to install unknown apps, tap Settings, turn on Allow from this source and go back. Then tap Install.

If Play Protect says it does not recognise the app, tap More details and then Install anyway. Updates arrive through the app itself.
